title: Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent
abstract: arXiv:2610.39417v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. translated_title: 规约明确且测试完备？基于自我进化智能体评估SWE-bench风格数据集
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在软件工程（SE）任务上展现出强大性能，这推动了对高质量数据集的需求，以实现可靠的训练与评估。SWE-bench风格数据集（SWE数据集）被广泛用于评估基于LLM的编程智能体在真实软件问题上的表现，其中任务清晰度与测试覆盖率直接决定了实例是否可求解、可验证。然而，现有SWE数据集中仍存在质量问题，且人工标注成本高、劳动强度大，因此催生了基于LLM的标注方法。现有方法通常依赖静态且过于宽泛的评分准则，这限制了其处理多样化和细微场景的能力，并常导致较高的误报率。相比之下，人类标注者会利用积累的经验做出具有上下文感知的判断。受此启发，我们提出了ExLabel——一个基于LLM、自我进化且经验引导的助手，用于评估任务清晰度与测试覆盖率。
tldr: 提出ExLabel——一个基于LLM、自我进化且经验引导的智能体助手，用于评估SWE-bench风格数据集的任务清晰度与测试覆盖率，克服了静态通用评分准则误报率高的缺陷。
en_tdlr: We propose ExLabel, an LLM-based, self-evolving, experience-guided agent for assessing task clarity and test coverage in SWE-bench-style datasets, addressing the high false positive rates of existing static and overly general rubric-based annotation methods.
